must_fix_used.claim_in_article: “The fee plan being withdrawn and worries about ships disappearing are separate matters.”
must_fix_used.issue: “Worries about ships disappearing” adds a specific concern that is not in the Ledger. The Japanese source says only that concerns about ships remained; it does not mention ships disappearing.
must_fix_used.explanation: The article changes the general tanker/ship safety concern in HF-009 into a specific concern about ships disappearing. This is an unsupported new factual detail introduced in translation.

advanced.title: The 20 Percent Plan Changes Shape. Oil Prices Remain Unsettled
